name: Stratagem Probe (research)
description: Research for Commando Plus: can a Resupply be delivered somewhere other than where its beacon landed (at the reinforcement pods)? Hooks the game's beacon activation; for every Resupply thrown, stratagem-probe.ini picks: redirect (default: to the nearest pod site in Commando, else 20 m east), copies (one more per pod site), observe. Logs where everything lands. 0.2.0: two test stratagems in the loadout (supply): Rack Test D (a Call In Destroyer copy dropping the reward rack) and Rack Test O (the reward rack with the Destroyer call's origin). Turn off when done.
